name: Boyden outward-flow water turbine
description: An outward-flow hydraulic turbine converted water power to rotational mechanical work.

places.note: Modern country or regional reference; historic political boundaries are not implied.

date.basis: The cited source dates this event.

events.statement: Uriah Boyden developed an outward-flow hydraulic turbine, improving an earlier Fourneyron design.
events.caveats: Reported improvement is the institution’s assessment; no quantified performance comparison is assigned to 1844.

evidence.supports: ASME dates Boyden’s invention and identifies the prior Fourneyron turbine.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest event sourced for this particular record; not a claim of global origin.

caveats: The Fourneyron turbine preceded this development. Later Cohoes mill output does not date to the invention.
